message.desc-differential-flow-meter: available only for DIN1. In this configuration, the direct flow meter must be connected to DIN0, and the return flow meter to DIN1. message.alarm-sms-description: The alarm is triggered when the SOS button is pressed or when the battery level is low. When an alarm occurs, pressing the SOS button will cause the terminal to send an SMS with the text "device name: ALARM" to the specified phone numbers (up to 4). When the battery level is low, an SMS with the text "device name: battery low!" will be sent. Below you can specify phone numbers for notifications.

message.tooltip-coordinates-detection-source: This parameter defines whether coordinates should be determined during activity and specifies their source.
message.tooltip-minimum-activity-time: Minimum activity time — the period during which the tracker will remain active even if all required tasks are completed. This allows time to receive an incoming SMS containing a command.
message.tooltip-maximum-activity-time: Maximum activity time — the period after which the tracker will enter sleep mode even if not all required tasks were completed, such as determining coordinates or sending data to the server.
message.tooltip-sleep-time: Sleep time — the period during which the tracker will remain in sleep mode if all required tasks were successfully completed.
message.tooltip-sleep-time-after-error: Sleep time after error — the period during which the tracker will remain in sleep mode if tasks were not completed or errors occurred, such as failure to connect to the server.
message.tooltip-rs485-reader-address: RS-485 bus reader address. Make sure the configured device has the same address.
message.tooltip-freeze-coordinates-on-parking: Coordinate freezing while parked is enabled when the vehicle ignition is turned off.
message.tooltip-speed-threshold: Lower speed threshold at which a point will be recorded.

message.device-add-instruction-step-1: Currently, the NeoSync service supports the following models: ADM007 / 007BLE / 333 / 333BLE / 333V2 / 333v3 / ADM500 / ADM P50 / ADM P50 LTE.
message.device-add-instruction-step-2: Firmware version must be at least 0x38 for ADM007 / 007BLE / 333 / 333BLE / 333V2 / 333v3 devices. For ADM P50/ADM P50 LTE — not lower than 0x10. For ADM500 — not lower than 0x07.
message.device-add-instruction-step-3: If necessary, update the devices using the UPDATE command or any other convenient method.
message.device-add-instruction-step-4: On ADM P50 and ADM500 models, the remote configuration function is disabled by default. To enable it, send the command REMOTECFG 1. This setting remains active until a full factory reset or until it is manually disabled.
message.device-add-instruction-step-5: Next, you need to add a tracker or import a list of IMEIs into your NeoSync account. Access to the tracker settings window becomes available only after the tracker connects to the NeoSync server for the first time.
